images.alt_grc: ἄνω ἐπὶ τῷ τείχει οἱ Ἀθηναῖοι τὸν καπνὸν ὁρῶσιν ἐκ τῶν ἀγρῶν ἀναβαίνοντα.
images.alt_en: Athenians crowd the top of the city wall in summer; far off across the plain, columns of smoke rise over Acharnae below Mount Parnes.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Εὔδημος ὀργίζεται· ὁ δὲ Ἀρίστων καὶ ὁ Κλεινίας πρὸς τὰς Ἀχαρνὰς ὁρῶσιν.
images.alt_en: On the wall-walk: Eudemos, a sturdy charcoal-burner with blackened hands, shouts and points; Ariston holds his arm; old Kleinias and Lysis look out towards the smoke.

images.alt_grc: ἐν τῇ πόλει οἱ Ἀθηναῖοι ἐν πολλῇ ἔριδί εἰσιν· χρησμολόγος χρησμοὺς ᾄδει.
images.alt_en: A street in Athens: groups of citizens argue, young men gesture towards the gates, an oracle-singer chants from a scroll.
An army on the march: hoplites in column with shields and spears, from a Greek vase painting.
Fire burning a farmhouse roof and a field of grain.
A man cutting down a vine or an olive tree with an axe.

images.alt_grc: ἡ ἅμαξα πρὸς τὰς πύλας ἀφικνεῖται· ἐπ' αὐτῇ κλῖναι καὶ ὑδρίαι καὶ ἡ θύρα τῆς οἰκίας.
images.alt_en: An ox-cart piled with beds, jars, a loom frame and a wooden house door arrives at the Acharnian Gate among many other carts; Mikion walks beside it with a goat.

images.alt_grc: ἡ Χρυσὶς τὴν Φιλίππην δέχεται· ὁ δὲ Εὔδημος τὰ ζῷα λύει.
images.alt_en: Inside the gate: Chrysis embraces her cousin Philippe; Eudemos unyokes the oxen; Lysis and Mikion eye each other.

images.alt_grc: οἱ Ἀθηναῖοι ἐκ τῶν ἀγρῶν τὰ ξύλα τῶν οἰκιῶν κομίζουσιν· τὰ δὲ πρόβατα εἰς Εὔβοιαν πέμπεται.
images.alt_en: Country people taking the roof-beams and doors from their farmhouses and loading carts; in the distance, sheep being driven down to boats bound for Euboea.
A four-wheeled ox-cart (terracotta model or vase painting).
Farm animals together: oxen, sheep, goats and a donkey.
A man carrying household goods on his back towards a city gate.
Black-figure vase painting of an ox-drawn cart (a wedding or farm cart).

images.alt_grc: ἐν τῷ πύργῳ οἰκοῦσιν ἡ Φιλίππη καὶ ὁ Εὔδημος καὶ ὁ Μικίων.
images.alt_en: Inside a tower of the city wall: straw mats, a small hearth, jars and a hanging cloak; Philippe fans a crying neighbour's baby, Mikion sits in the narrow window.

images.alt_grc: πολλοὶ Ἀθηναῖοι ἐν τοῖς ἱεροῖς καὶ ἐν τοῖς πύργοις σκηνοῦσιν.
images.alt_en: The crowded city: families camping with bedding and pots in the precinct of a small shrine and along the foot of the wall below the Acropolis.

images.alt_grc: ἡ Χρυσὶς καὶ ἡ Ἐλπὶς τῇ ἱερείᾳ τὸ ὕφασμα παραδιδόασιν.
images.alt_en: Panathenaea: the procession climbs to the Acropolis; to one side, Chrysis and Elpis hand a folded woven cloth to Athena's priestess.
A square stone tower of a Greek city wall (e.g. the towers of Messene or Aigosthena).
One person handing a folded cloth to another.
Parthenon frieze, east side: the folding of the peplos, and women of the procession.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Ἀρίστων ὁπλίτης ὢν μετὰ τοῦ στρατοῦ εἰς τὴν Μεγαρίδα βαδίζει.
images.alt_en: Autumn: a long column of Athenian hoplites on the road to Megara; Ariston in bronze helmet, shield on his back, beside Simon the metic.

images.alt_grc: αἱ ἅμαξαι τὰς λάρνακας φέρουσιν· μία δὲ κλίνη κενὴ φέρεται.
images.alt_en: Winter funeral procession: wagons carry cypress coffins, one for each tribe, and an empty bier draped with cloth; women mourn walking behind.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Περικλῆς ἐπὶ βῆμα ὑψηλὸν ἀναβὰς λέγει.
images.alt_en: The public cemetery outside the Dipylon Gate: Pericles speaks from a high platform over a large crowd; Lysis and Mikion listen at the front.
A hoplite with round shield, spear and Corinthian helmet (red-figure vase).
A grave marker and burial mound in the Kerameikos cemetery.
Mourners lowering a coffin into a grave.
A fragment of an Athenian public casualty list: names inscribed tribe by tribe on marble (5th century BC).
